description: ecommerce-app backend monorepo - service port declarations and the resolved runtime projection for offset 69, shaped like nivo-backend's metadata.json. Source allocation lives in the host registry (.workspaces/ports/, slot step 1000): port = basePort + appSlot*1000 + offset. This file is the resolved projection, not a second allocation: apps and .starcistacks fragments READ their numbers from here so no port literal exists that could drift, and the FE lane's ports are documented beside the BE's the way nivo documents its web apps. The host registry has no ecommerce-app.json entry yet (offset 69 is what the orchestrating plan assigned; writing that file is a host-registry action, outside this repository's boundary).

landing.ownedBy: the fe side (fe/apps; declared here so its apps read the same projection)

shop.ownedBy: the fe side (fe/apps; declared here so its apps read the same projection)

secrets.note: The local Postgres runs with trust authentication. Keycloak's bootstrap admin password and the identity-admin client secret are sealed in secrets/keycloak-env.enc, MinIO's root password in secrets/minio-env.enc (SOPS+age, DEMO-ONLY recipient); runtime/env/*.env are their decrypted members and are never tracked.
